title: Select and verify one scalar routine on three machines
statement: After both real-ISA adapters work, select one extension-free scalar routine and complete its A0, RV64, x86-64, refinement, evidence, control, and scoped cost-accounting package.

evidence.note: The exact complete programs have a finite three-machine execution, typed relation, evidence, control, and scoped static and dynamic cost-accounting package. The Chapter 15 research contract explicitly makes no optimization or minimality claim; bounded scalar minimality is the separate Chapter 13 obligation.
